title: Apple AirPods Max 2  – $799 Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: Apple AirPods Max 2  – $799 Delivered @ Amazon AU

[freelife] Anyone able to comment on how it compares with Bose QC Ultra 2? Especially comfort, sound stage and ANC?
[Zippy7] As someone who has a fatter/wider head, I found the Sony NC to be a tighter fit, and the ear cup was not big enough (pressed my ears in and was painful/uncomfortable after not long)
I bought a gen 1 AP Max and they sit nicely and are comfortable and work well.
My son uses them now, and I'm using a pair of Bose NC700
It all depends on what you value most - I prioritised comfort because I used them on Zoom/Teams calls.
I'm not a big audiophile - they all sound decent to me.
Of course, YMMV
[BargainHunterD] LOL ridiculous price for a set of headphones you cant even enjoy lossless audio through.
[deanylev] You literally can listen to lossless audio through them?
[AustriaBargain] If you plug them in then you do get lossless audio, even on Android.
[YoursTruly] Apple on sale. Apple in sane. What’s the difference?
[chrisby] Only 2 colours at this price - Blue and Starlight @ $799.
Midnight, Orange and Purple remain @ $999.
[Nephail] I’m not sure how many people these days can afford $799 headphones, and of that group, how many actually use OzBargain.
[nikoris] 'Why do some people have more money than me'
[Nillionaire] Many people can afford $799 headphones, you can go to an airport to see the highest concentration of AirPod Max. Many people can afford ~$400 headphones, you can go to a university campus or gym to see highest concentration of Sony XMs. Many of them are on OzBargain as past upvotes indicate. OzBargain has many high earners / high spenders.

The ATL is $759 at Officeworks via Price Beat of MSY which is no longer obtainable.
You can also see how low the AirPod Max 1 (Gen 1 • Lightning) and AirPod Max 1 (Gen 2 • USB C) dropped before if you want to wait.
